policy: Unknown data license blocks training, adaptation and product output. Code and article licenses never replace data licenses.

datasets.name: Swiss Dwellings v3.0.0
datasets.floor_information: floor_id, plan_id, elevation; not guaranteed full home
datasets.license: CC-BY-4.0
datasets.derived_model_distribution: permitted under licensed-data grant with attribution; no weights trained
datasets.quality_notes: Repeated floors, generic ROOM, incomplete opening associations; exact source polygons retained
datasets.aura_decision: Selected canonical source; full scan, quarantine unsupported imports

datasets.name: Modified Swiss Dwellings v2
datasets.format: raster NPY, vector geometry and graphs
datasets.license: CC-BY-4.0
datasets.derived_model_distribution: permitted for licensed data; code/weights separate
datasets.quality_notes: Derived from Swiss; 5.5 GB; some test releases have inputs only
datasets.aura_decision: Eligible alternative; no second download of overlapping source; no training

datasets.name: ResPlan
datasets.region: Not reliably specified in inspected release
datasets.doors_windows: both; direct adjacency differs from door connectivity
datasets.license: CC-BY-4.0 data; MIT code; grant scoped to author contributions
datasets.derived_model_distribution: conditional on scope and takedown maintenance; original listing images not licensed
datasets.quality_notes: Publisher reports near duplicates and train/test leakage; source listing rights excluded from grant
datasets.aura_decision: Candidate; original images not used; no product corpus admission in this delivery

datasets.name: Oriented-Environmental Swiss Dwellings
datasets.license: Not verified from accessible primary metadata
datasets.quality_notes: Derived source; location fields need minimization
datasets.aura_decision: Excluded until license and exact fields verified

datasets.name: ModRes
datasets.license: Dataset release license not verified; paper license is not data license
datasets.quality_notes: Cleaned ResPlan derivative, not independent geography

datasets.name: PUBLICPLAN
datasets.license: Unverified; publisher/API returned anti-bot page
datasets.quality_notes: Architect-designed proposals; raster scale unknown; no bypass attempted
datasets.aura_decision: Excluded pending explicit commercial license and scale

datasets.name: CABE Dwelling Size Study
datasets.format: XLS measured areas + PDF plan sheets
datasets.metric_scale: m2 in raw table; plan dimensions per sheet require check
datasets.floor_information: houses and flats; exact level semantics require sheets
datasets.license: OGL catalog record; third-party plan rights require file check
datasets.commercial_use: catalog/statistics permitted; plan grant not verified
datasets.quality_notes: Historic archive links; no raw workbook or PDF reused
datasets.aura_decision: Candidate for UK statistical comparison; not in corpus

datasets.name: Affordable housing floor plan dataset
datasets.region: England, Chile, China, Netherlands, Spain, Switzerland
datasets.metric_scale: area attributes, not complete metric geometry
datasets.license: CC-BY-NC
datasets.quality_notes: Tables rather than ready-to-import vector geometry

datasets.name: CubiCasa5K
datasets.metric_scale: not a uniformly verified real-metre source
datasets.license: CC-BY-NC-4.0
datasets.quality_notes: Parsing benchmark; uneven image scales and vectorization needed

datasets.name: RPLAN
datasets.region: Asia; exact country not independently confirmed
datasets.license: Access on request; redistribution/commercial grant not verified
datasets.quality_notes: Near duplicates; Manhattan alignment; no compass basis
datasets.aura_decision: Excluded; no raw download or derivative statistics

datasets.name: LIFULL HOMES
datasets.license: NII research-only agreement
datasets.quality_notes: Institutional application; onward distribution restricted

datasets.name: Structured3D
datasets.region: Designer-generated; not a verified country sample
datasets.license: Custom Structured3D Terms of Use; MIT code is separate
datasets.quality_notes: Synthetic professional designs; agreement required
datasets.aura_decision: Excluded; code license does not license data

datasets.name: 3D-FRONT
datasets.license: 3D-FRONT Data Sets Use License Agreement
datasets.quality_notes: Original portal currently unavailable; custom terms are decisive

datasets.name: FloorPlanCAD
datasets.metric_scale: 20x20 m blocks reported; original release check needed
datasets.license: Public project license not presently verified; mirrors say CC-BY-NC
datasets.quality_notes: Project shutdown; no mirror license override accepted

datasets.name: Zillow Indoor Dataset
datasets.region: Residential home sample; country not independently audited here
datasets.license: ZInD academic-only data terms; Apache code separate
datasets.quality_notes: Unfurnished homes; access requires institution verification

datasets.name: HouseExpo
datasets.doors_windows: navigation openings, not verified construction openings
datasets.license: MIT repository code; underlying SUNCG data grant not established
datasets.quality_notes: Synthetic and inherited rights; not observed real housing

datasets.name: FloorNet scans
datasets.license: MIT repository; separate raw-data grant not verified
datasets.quality_notes: 135/20 scans; code license does not automatically clear data

datasets.name: Rent3D

datasets.name: MagicPlan / PuzzleFusion
datasets.license: Research-community sharing stated; commercial dataset grant not verified

datasets.name: CVC-FP
